capabilities: Open registered vaults from a dock of tiles
Switch vaults on desktop with hide, close, or keep-both window modes
Customize tile appearance with images, colors, and initials
Reorder, resize, and reposition the dock bar
Show built-in vaults as tappable tiles on mobile
extras: Formerly published under the vault-switcher-bar plugin ID; the README gives removal instructions for the old build and notes a Wayland limitation where window position cannot be transferred. Runs offline.
problem: Obsidian's built-in vault switcher gives no persistent visual panel and no control over how windows behave when moving between vaults.
summary: Tile-dock panel that opens and switches between registered Obsidian vaults on desktop and mobile, with customizable tiles and switching modes.
